caption: The drawing depicts an architectural scene featuring a central arched doorway with a wooden double door. The archway above the door is constructed with alternating red and cream segments, with red bricks at the base of each side. The doorway is flanked by two columns matching the color of the arch, set on rectangular stone bases. The ground in front of the door consists of a tiled floor in reddish and brownish tones. Above the door, there is a small, arched window accented with a similar red and cream pattern, with black shutters partially open. On either side of the window, there are decorative painted vases with stylized flowers in soft red and brown lines. The background is a lightly shaded cream wall that fades upward into a light blue and cream blend, with wooden ceiling beams visible above the arched window. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner, reading "Geoffrey Holt" and underneath that, "after Harry Marian Waddell."
title: Restoration Drawing: Main Doorway & Arch to Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
